description: A KPMG survey of 47 countries found that 69 percent of people in China believe AI benefits outweigh risks, compared to 35 percent in the United States.

instances.assertion: A KPMG survey of 47 countries found that 69 percent of people in China believe AI benefits outweigh risks, compared to 35 percent in the United States.
A KPMG survey from 2025 found that 69 percent of people in China believe AI's benefits outweigh its risks, compared to only 35 percent of Americans.
